title: Sea salt hair spray
subtitle: A volumising and texturising spray for natural wave and grip
excerpt: Sea salt hair spray is a volumising and texturising spray made from Epsom salts and sea salt dissolved in warm water, with a small addition of coconut oil and aloe vera gel. Sprayed onto damp or dry hair, it creates a natural wave and grip without crunch or residue. Makes 200 ml in a spray bottle; keeps two weeks at room temperature or four weeks in the fridge.
sourceNotes: Sea salt texturising spray: widely used in hairdressing; the technique of using dissolved sea salt for wave enhancement documented in Toni & Guy Style Notes (2015) and The Hair Bible by Philip Kingsley (2000). Magnesium sulphate (Epsom salts) as a volumiser: lighter than sodium chloride and adds soft hold. Coconut oil prevents excessive drying from the salt. Aloe vera gel as a light humectant and hold agent: The Complete Book of Essential Oils and Aromatherapy by Valerie Wormwood (1991).

recipe.batchNotes: Make a small batch (200 ml) and use within the shelf life. This formula contains no preservative.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Shake before each use, the coconut oil will separate if allowed to cool. Make small batches and use fresh.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Two weeks at room temperature; four weeks refrigerated. This formula contains water and no preservative, discard if the liquid turns cloudy or develops any smell other than the faint coconut note. Add 1% broad-spectrum preservative to extend to three months.

glossaryTerms.definition: The thick gel from the inner leaf of Aloe barbadensis, used in cosmetics as a light conditioning agent and hold booster. In hair spray it adds a gentle grip without the crunchiness of an alcohol-based spray.

content.text: Warm the distilled water to about 60°C. Add the Epsom salts and sea salt and stir until fully dissolved. Add the aloe vera gel and stir. Add the melted coconut oil and stir. Pour into the spray bottle while still warm to prevent the coconut oil from re-solidifying. Shake well before each use.

Shake the bottle well, then spray onto damp hair from root to tip. Scrunch the hair upward to encourage wave and texture. Leave to air dry or diffuse. Can also be sprayed on dry hair for added grip and separation between sections. Start with a light application, build up if more texture is needed.
Two weeks at room temperature, four weeks in the fridge. This formula has no preservative, discard if the liquid turns cloudy or smells off. Shake before every use.
